_edit: One entry per release, newest first; add the new release at the top and keep the older ones (a Mac that skipped releases steps back through them on the card). version is the release number (csproj <Version>), 2 to 4 items. title says what it is, how says where to click to try it now. icon is one of sparkles, armchair, activity, link, book-open, rocket, box, camera, git-compare, info (Lucide).

items.title: Guided AI detection
items.how: Tap + in an empty file: one card walks you through choosing a PDF or scan, setting the scale, reviewing and generating 3D.

items.title: Interior and exterior render
items.how: Pick a room's floor for More actions → Interior render, or More actions → Exterior render: materials, soft shadows, any side. Then Export viewport saves it as a PNG.

items.title: Daylight map in the analysis set
items.how: Print analysis set now adds a top-view daylight map, and runs daylight for you if it hasn't run.

items.title: Info panel
items.how: Click a room, door, window or wall: the top of the window shows its sizes, and you can change them right there.

items.title: View picker
items.how: Tap the cube at the top left of the Forsk window for Perspective, Plan or an elevation.

items.title: Interior render
items.how: Click a room's floor, then More actions → Interior render. The view shows the materials and is saved after the room.

items.title: Saved options
items.how: Analyses menu → Options: save the model as option A, B, …, then compare or restore it.

items.title: Furnish a room
items.how: Ask in chat: furnish the bedroom. Pick the blue or orange layout on the card.

items.title: Live analyses
items.how: Tap the purple Analyser face at the top, then switch Live on for Daylight or Areas.

items.title: Connect Rhino to your account
items.how: Settings → Set up Forsk → Account → Connect, then confirm the code in your browser.
